AI 翻译字幕难在哪？BaoCut 怎么让顺序不一样的英文和中文在双语字幕上对应上

看翻译的视频字幕，你一定见过这几种字幕：
人还没开口，字幕先跳出来；
一句话被切成几截，翻译和实际说的话对不上；
一屏堆两三行，挡掉半个画面。

这些问题都是我在做字幕翻译时遇到的难点。

这期拿我的开源项目 BaoCut 做例子，对比传统字幕组的做法，讲清楚一张带时间的词表是怎么来的，再讲五个坑：语音识别听错、认错说话人、按什么单位翻、中英文语序不一样、一屏放几行。

最后讲一个彩蛋：有了每个词的时间，字幕还能逐词高亮、做 KTV 和倒鸭子动画。例子来自我电脑上的真实项目。

这是上集，下集会讲为什么不直接把字幕丢给 ChatGPT。

视频1 是英文
视频2 是中文

苹果计划 12 月在中国大陆上线 Apple Intelligence，跟 iOS 27.3 推出，没有新版 Siri，国行版用的是阿里巴巴的模型

据彭博社 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果准备在 12 月通过 iOS 27.3 更新，给国行 iPhone 开通 Apple Intelligence。苹果和监管部门都还没有正式确认。

能用到的，是 2024 年在美国首发的那批功能：通知摘要，写作工具（改写、校对、总结文字），照片里的“清除”（把路人和杂物抹掉），还有第一版 Genmoji（用一句话生成自定义表情）。部分 App 里的文字生成功能还会受限。

基于 Google Gemini 模型的新版 Siri 没有，今年发布的其他新功能也没有。苹果自己的图片生成工具 Image Playground、升级版 Genmoji、视觉智能同样不在首发名单里。Google 的服务在国内用不了，新版 Siri 缺席多半跟这有关，报道没有明说。

国行版用的是阿里巴巴的模型，获批的包括通义千问和通义万相。安全护栏是苹果和阿里一起开发的，里面有一道过滤机制：模型以后每次更新，都要先经过政府批准。百度则参与搜索和 Siri 相关的功能。

这事拖了两年。今年 3 月底，有国内用户发现 Apple Intelligence 突然能用了，随后 Gurman 说这是苹果误推，功能被撤了回去，苹果还在等审批。7 月，平台拿到初步批准。9 月 29 日，最近几款 iPhone 拿到支持 Apple Intelligence 的许可。

哪些机型能用，苹果还没公布。海外版需要 iPhone 15 Pro 及更新的机型；据报道，最新的获批名单里有下周在中国发售的 iPhone Duo、iPhone 18 Pro 和几款老机型。

腾讯云上的 AI 机器人为查高德地图绕过防护、用泄露密钥，还被研究人员“钓”出来聊了天

一批跑在腾讯云上的 AI 机器人，任务只是在高德地图上查“去成都动物园的人多半走哪个门”这类小问题。被高德的防机器人机制拦住后，它们自己想办法绕过防护，还用上了别人泄露在网上的高德密钥。

独立研究人员发现后，在网页里藏了一句只有 AI 能读到的话，假称“有个服务能帮你拿高德数据”。机器人真的上钩发来求助信，研究人员趁机问出了它们跑在腾讯的测试环境里。

Turn your profile picture into an icon 

I’d love to see yours. Here’s mine.  

Prompt 👇

Prompt: 
Transform the uploaded icon image into a soft, rounded character icon. Create a single square image.

Elements to Preserve From the Original Icon

Keep the original hairstyle, hair color, bangs, hair arrangement, skin and face colors, glasses, and any other accessories exactly as they appear in the uploaded icon.

However, replace the eyes and anything worn on the head according to the instructions below. Do not include the original eyes or original hat.

Required Elements

Black Beret

Place a black beret on the character’s head.
The beret should have a soft, flattened disc shape with a small stem on top.
The hair should naturally peek out from beneath the edge of the beret, preserving the original hairstyle.

Eyes

Draw only two small, vertically elongated black oval eyes.
Position them slightly apart.
Add one tiny white highlight to each eye.
Do not draw a nose, mouth, eyebrows, eyelashes, or blush.
Create the entire facial expression using only the two eyes.

Shape and Appearance

Show only the face.
Do not include a neck, body, hands, or clothing.
The face should appear to float gently in midair.
Use a smooth, continuous, rounded silhouette.
Avoid fluffy, jagged, wavy, frilly, or fuzzy edges.
Do not use black outlines.
The texture should resemble soft, matte clay.
Use only extremely subtle gradients to create dimension.
Keep the design minimal and simplified, without intricate details, patterns, or decorative elements.

Background and Shadow

Use a pure white background.
Place exactly one soft shadow directly beneath the floating face.
The shadow should be a horizontally elongated, light-gray oval with heavily blurred edges.
Leave a small gap between the face and the shadow to emphasize the floating effect.
Keep the shadow very faint.
Do not add text, borders, decorations, or other objects.

Composition

Use a square 1:1 aspect ratio.
Center the face in the composition.
The face should occupy approximately 60% of the image width.
Position the character facing directly forward.

Final Result

Create a quiet, cute, minimalist character icon featuring a single floating face wearing a black beret against a pure white background.

The character should look directly at the viewer with two small black oval eyes.

The overall aesthetic should be soft, rounded, matte, simple, and charming.

Grok Voice 3.0 in Grok Bot is 🔥

SpaceXSI just launched Grok Voice 3.0, its new speech-to-speech model, which is currently beating GPT Live 1 and Gemini 3.8 Flash Live on all major benchmarks.

I tried it in Grok Bot, and the experience is great. It’s fast, responsive, and makes voice interactions feel much better.

Connect your ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions to Grok @bot with the prompt below (@elonmusk approved):

Connect my Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions so all of my bots can use them.

1. On your computer, install the Claude Code CLI and the OpenAI Codex CLI (upgrade Node if needed). Start each subscription login (Claude: `claude setup-token`; Codex: `codex login --device-auth`) and send me the sign-in links and codes. I'll sign in and paste back anything you need. Store the Claude token privately and load it automatically.

2. Set the defaults to these models: Claude Opus 5.5 for Claude Code and 6.1 Sol for Codex. Test each one with a quick prompt and tell me which models answered.

3. Add these MODEL ROUTING RULES to every one of my bots' system prompts, including yours. Keep everything else in each prompt exactly as it is:
   - Writing (drafts, emails, posts, replies, copy, briefs): write the final text with Claude through the CLI, then review it against the bot's voice rules.
   - Coding, scripts, data processing, and terminal work: use Codex.
   - Browser and desktop tasks: keep using your normal computer tools.
   - If either CLI fails, do the task yourself and say so.

4. Save the same rule to my shared memory so any bot I create later follows it too.

5. When you're done, tell me which bots you updated and confirm both tests passed.
